name: Anointing Of The Holy Spirit
overview: The anointing of the Holy Spirit is a divine act that sets apart individuals for God’s service, as seen in the anointing of Aaron and his sons to the priesthood, establishing an everlasting ministry (Exodus 40:13-15). This anointing, typified by holy oil, signifies God's empowering presence and protection, exemplified in His anointing of David, where God’s strength ensures that enemies will not prevail against him (Psalms 89:20-22). Thus, Scripture reveals the anointing as both a sanctifying and sustaining work of God that equips and preserves His servants.
